Iranian army: War could be longer than previous one, Trump won't dictate its duration
Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said that the purpose of the ongoing talks was to continue consultations with the Qatari mediators, adding that Tehran was prepared for "both defense and diplomacy."
Qatari broadcaster Al Jazeera quoted Araghchi as saying that Iranian and Qatari negotiators had developed a proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within two days of a potential agreement with Washington. Araghchi said discussions on a "two-day proposal" were continuing, but that no final conclusion had been reached.
Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy said two oil tankers "exploded" after striking mines while traveling through an "unauthorized route" in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran has imposed restrictions on vessels seeking to pass through the Strait of Hormuz and has attacked ships it says violate those restrictions, as it seeks to assert control over the strategic waterway and exert pressure on the US.
